neighbours.label: the West seen from Asia: ' west', ' Western', 'ers' in West+ers, ' European', ' roman' characters, in text about Japan or China, firing on those words; 'Western Union' and other adjectives in the same frames stay low
fire: For centuries Korea stayed closed to the west.
